name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One run at a time: each run asks `callisto release pending` what is unfinished when it starts, so a run queued behind
# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]] && selected_pending=true
            release_source_sha="${release_source_sha:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "release_pr_number=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$prs")"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release just executed is excluded: a release that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

toolUseResult.stdout:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One run at a time: each run asks `callisto release pending` what is unfinished when it starts, so a run queued behind
# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]] && selected_pending=true
            release_source_sha="${release_source_sha:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "release_pr_number=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$prs")"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release just executed is excluded: a release that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

content.content:
name: Callisto CI & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workflow-contracts:
    name: Workflow Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install workflow validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep,zizmor@1.30.0
      - name: Lint workflow and action metadata
        # actionlint v1.7.12 predates GitHub's documented $/ self-repository
        # syntax. Keep all other actionlint diagnostics strict.
        uses: docker://rhysd/actionlint@sha256:9d36088643581e728c969f35141f88139fec77280b2be23c1f66f8e40e1025e7 # v1.7.12
        with:
          # Docker action arguments are passed directly, rather than through a
          # shell. Keep the exception as one argument so its regex is intact.
          args: -color -ignore=\$/.+
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Audit workflow and action security
        run: just zizmor
      - name: Verify workflow contracts
        run: just workflow-contracts

  fmt:
    name: Code Formatting (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: just fmt-check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy Lints (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: just lint
      - run: just doc-check
      - run: just fuzz-check

  msrv:
    name: Minimum Supported Rust Version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the declared rust-version
        run: |
          msrv=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          rustup toolchain install "$msrv" --profile minimal
          echo "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=$msrv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked

  test:
    name: Test Suite (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

content.content:
name: 'Callisto Release-PR Action'
description: 'Creates or updates a Callisto release PR; durable execution belongs to the repository workflow'
inputs:
  version_command:
    description: 'Version command; defaults to callisto version, which refreshes lockfiles. Callisto appends --emit-decision <decision_path>.'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto version'
  decision_path:
    description: 'Path, relative to cwd, where the version command records the exact release decision this PR carries. Committed alongside the manifest and changelog edits; `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` verifies the merged commit against this file rather than re-deriving release policy.'
    required: false
    default: '.callisto/release-decision.json'
  commit_message:
    description: 'Release-PR commit message'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  title:
    description: 'Release-PR title'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  pr_label:
    description: 'Release-PR label'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto: release'
  branch:
    description: 'Base branch for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'main'
  release_branch:
    description: 'Branch managed for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto/version-packages'
  github_token:
    description: 'Optional GitHub token for pull-request and forge commit API operations. The managed branch is never pushed with `git push`; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient even on a public repository, since the executor never writes `.github/workflows/*`.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` published anything (mode: release only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` published (mode: release only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate mode
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/validate-mode.sh"

# OIDC trusted publishing

Plan, not behavior: nothing here ships before it is built, and the specs describe only what exists. Target: after v1. Delete this file when the work ships.

## Goal

Publish to npm, crates.io and PyPI with no long-lived registry secret in the repository. The CI job proves its identity with a short-lived GitHub OIDC token, and each registry accepts it for a package that names that repository and workflow as a trusted publisher.

## What each registry needs

| Registry | Trusted publisher is set up | The job must | Token reaches the tool by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm | per package on npmjs.com: owner, repository, workflow file, optional environment | have `id-token: write`; run npm 11.5.1 or later (Node 24 ships it) | npm detects the OIDC environment itself and prefers it over a token. No secret |
| crates.io | per crate in its settings, after a first manual publish | have `id-token: write`; run `rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action`, which exchanges the OIDC token for a short-lived crates.io token and revokes it when the job ends | the action's `token` output, passed to `cargo publish` as `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` |
| PyPI | per project on pypi.org: owner, repository, workflow file, optional environment | have `id-token: write`; mint an upload token through PyPI's OIDC exchange | PyPI documents the exchange as an implementation detail; the stable interfaces are `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` and `uv publish`. Twine takes the minted token as `TWINE_PASSWORD` with `TWINE_USERNAME=__token__` |

A mismatch in owner, repository, workflow file or environment fails, and npm reports it as a misleading E404. Self-hosted runners are not supported by npm. crates.io blocks the `pull_request_target` and `workflow_run` triggers.

## Where Callisto stands

- Generated workflows already give `execute` `id-token: write` (for npm provenance), so the permission itself is not new there. Callisto's own release workflow does not: its policy check allows `id-token: write` only on `build-artifact`.
- Callisto passes the environment through to the tool and never strips `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` or `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN`, so npm can see them. ADR 4 keeps authentication with the ecosystem tool, which fits: Callisto does not need to mint tokens.
- The generated action writes a temporary npm config with an `NPM_TOKEN` entry. With no token set that line may stop npm falling back to OIDC. Unverified.
- Twine is the PyPI uploader, and it cannot mint a token.

## Work

1. Decide the shape: a `callisto.toml` switch, or a generated-workflow option, for "this registry publishes by OIDC", so no secret input is expected for it.
2. npm: omit the token entry from the generated npm config when OIDC is chosen, and check the pnpm, yarn and bun publish paths. Only `npm publish` is documented to use OIDC, so each package manager must be tested.
3. crates.io: generate the auth-action step before `execute` and pass its output as `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`.
4. PyPI: mint the token in a generated step, or use `uv publish` where it is available; keep twine for the token path.
5. Diagnostics: an E163 hint for the npm E404 case that names the trusted-publisher fields to recheck.
6. Policy and docs: the release workflow policy check, `docs/publishing.md`, the init docs and the generated-workflow tests.

## Decisions for the owner

- Callisto's own workflow: allow `id-token: write` on `execute`? With OIDC there is no registry secret at all, which is the intent of "only `execute` gets registry secrets", but the policy check forbids the permission and changing it is the owner's call. A GitHub Environment stays out either way.
- One job holds the OIDC permission while the project's own build code runs (cargo build scripts during `cargo publish` verification, npm lifecycle scripts). That is also true of a long-lived token today, and a short-lived scoped token is strictly less exposed. Keeping the build in a separate job (the current build-artifact split) limits it further.

## Verification

Needs real packages, so it is owner-run. For each registry: configure a scratch package's trusted publisher, run a release from a scratch repository with no token set, and confirm the version appears and the tag and release are created. Include a deliberately wrong workflow name per registry and check the diagnostic. Local registries (Verdaccio, pypiserver, cargo-http-registry) cannot exercise OIDC, so they cover only the no-token configuration paths.

## Sources

- npm: https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers
- crates.io: https://github.com/rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action and https://blog.rust-lang.org/2025/07/11/crates-io-development-update-2025-07
- PyPI: https://docs.pypi.org/trusted-publishers/using-a-publisher/

    permissions: {contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        with: {version: callisto@__VERSION__}

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:

          merge-multiple: true

        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        env:
          HAS_PYTHON: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_python }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets"
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json")
          if [[ "$HAS_PYTHON" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-python); fi
          callisto release artifact-manifest "${args[@]}"
      - name: Execute the release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
        __RELEASE_ENV__

  push:

permissions: {}

    shell: bash

  version-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@3feff402ea4798c4708ec6fa09e402b956596598 # callisto@0.14.0
        with: {mode: version-pr, branch: main}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.release }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      napi_dirs: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dirs }}
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_artifacts }}
      has_python: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_python }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      # Content precondition, not release detection: `release plan` requires this commit to write its decision.
      - name: Check for a release decision
        id: decision
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release=false
          if git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
            release=true
          fi
          echo "release=$release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@3feff402ea4798c4708ec6fa09e402b956596598 # callisto@0.14.0
        with: {version: callisto@0.14.0}
      - name: Plan the release
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
      - name: Build the matrix from napi targets and artifact slots
        id: matrix
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          report="$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build and cannot fail the plan.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$report"
          napi=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="napi") | .targets[] | {kind: "napi"} + .]' "$report")
          slots=$(jq -c --slurpfile report "$report" '[.artifactSlots[] as $slot
            | ([$report[0].platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="cargo") | .targets[]
                | select(.artifactName == $slot.assetName and .triple == $slot.platform)] | first
              // error("callisto matrix has no entry for artifact slot \($slot.assetName)"))
            | {kind: "cargo"} + .]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json")

            echo "matrix=$(jq -cn --argjson napi "$napi" --argjson slots "$slots" '$napi + $slots')"
            echo "has_napi=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "has_artifacts=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$slots")"
            echo "has_python=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("pypi/")))] | length > 0' "$intent")"

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error

    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix != '[]'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions: {contents: read, id-token: write, attestations: write}
    env:
      KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
      PACKAGE_DIR: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
      PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.packageName }}
      MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ matrix.manifestPath }}
      ASSET: ${{ matrix.artifactName }}

        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup target add "$TRIPLE"
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5; fi
      - name: Build the napi addon
        if: matrix.kind == 'napi'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--platform --release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")

          if [[ -n "$MANIFEST_PATH" ]]; then args+=(--manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$MANIFEST_PATH"); fi
          (cd "${PACKAGE_DIR:-.}" && npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi build "${args[@]}")
      - if: matrix.kind == 'napi'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Build and archive the release artifact
        if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'

          set -euo pipefail
          cargo_bin=cargo
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then cargo_bin=cross; fi
          cd "${PACKAGE_DIR:-.}"
          "$cargo_bin" build --release --locked --target "$TRIPLE" --package "$PACKAGE"
          metadata=$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1)
          target_dir=$(jq -r .target_directory <<< "$metadata")
          temp=$RUNNER_TEMP
          if command -v cygpath > /dev/null; then target_dir=$(cygpath -u "$target_dir"); temp=$(cygpath -u "$temp"); fi
          case "$TRIPLE" in *windows*) suffix=.exe ;; wasm32-*) suffix=.wasm ;; *) suffix= ;; esac
          stage="$temp/release-stage"
          out="$temp/release-assets"
          mkdir -p "$stage" "$out"
          jq -r --arg package "$PACKAGE" '.packages[] | select(.name == $package) | .targets[]
            | select(.kind | index("bin")) | .name' <<< "$metadata" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
            cp "$target_dir/$TRIPLE/release/$bin$suffix" "$stage/"
          done
          if [[ -z "$(ls -A "$stage")" ]]; then
            echo "::error::$PACKAGE builds no binary target for $TRIPLE"
            exit 1
          fi
          cd "$stage"
          case "$ASSET" in
            *.tar.gz | *.tgz) tar -czf "$out/$ASSET" ./* ;;
            *.tar.xz) tar -cJf "$out/$ASSET" ./* ;;
            *.zip) if command -v zip > /dev/null; then zip -q "$out/$ASSET" ./*; else 7z a -bd "$out/$ASSET" ./* > /dev/null; fi ;;
            *)
              binaries=(./*)
              if [[ ${#binaries[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
                echo "::error::$ASSET is not an archive name, but $PACKAGE builds ${#binaries[@]} binaries"
                exit 1
              fi
              cp "${binaries[0]}" "$out/$ASSET"
              ;;
          esac
      - if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/${{ matrix.artifactName }}
      - if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: asset-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  # No registry credentials: the executing job uploads these exact files.
  build-python:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@3feff402ea4798c4708ec6fa09e402b956596598 # callisto@0.14.0
        with: {version: callisto@0.14.0}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Build the Python distributions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet build==1.4.4
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin:$PATH"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dist"
          callisto release build-python --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dist"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/python-dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  execute:
    needs: [plan, build, build-python]
    # A skipped build blocks only when it had nothing to build.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix == '[]')) &&
      (needs.build-python.result == 'success' || (needs.build-python.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python != 'true'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: {group: callisto-release-execute, cancel-in-progress: false}
    permissions: {contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0} # zizmor: ignore[artipacked] tag push needs persisted credentials
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@3feff402ea4798c4708ec6fa09e402b956596598 # callisto@0.14.0
        with: {version: callisto@0.14.0}
      - name: Install twine
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet twine==7.0.0
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup target add "$TRIPLE"
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5; fi
      - name: Build the napi addon
        if: matrix.kind == 'napi'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--platform --release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--use-cross); fi
          if [[ -n "$MANIFEST_PATH" ]]; then args+=(--manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$MANIFEST_PATH"); fi
          (cd "${PACKAGE_DIR:-.}" && npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi build "${args[@]}")
